name: Launch
description: The Launch Vehicle lifts off from Earth and carries the Mission into orbit.
failureDescription: The Launch Vehicle broke up on the way to orbit.

name: Tanker launch
description: A Tanker lifts off from Earth with propellant for the Orbital refuelling of the Mission waiting in orbit.
failureDescription: The Tanker broke up on the way to orbit, so the Mission can't take on the propellant it needs to leave for Mars.

name: Rendezvous
description: The Mission meets the Tanker in Earth orbit, docks and fills its tanks for the journey to Mars.
failureDescription: The Mission and the Tanker collided as they docked, wrecking the Mission.

name: Mars transfer burn
description: The upper stage fires and sends the Mission out of Earth orbit towards Mars.
failureDescription: The upper stage shut down early, leaving the spacecraft on a path that will never reach Mars.

name: Mars orbit insertion
description: The orbiter fires its engine, slows down and is captured into orbit around Mars.
failureDescription: The engine didn't fire for long enough, and the spacecraft flew past Mars and off into space.

name: Entry/descent/landing
description: {lander} came through the atmosphere and touched down at {site}.
failureDescription: {lander} hit the ground too fast and crashed at {site}.

name: Mars ascent
description: The Crew lifted off from the surface of Mars and climbed into orbit, burning the ascent propellant made at their Landing Site.
failureDescription: The ascent engine failed as the Crew lifted off from the surface of Mars.

name: Mars orbit rendezvous
description: The Crew met their Earth return stage in Mars orbit and docked with it.
failureDescription: The Crew couldn't dock with their Earth return stage and were stranded in Mars orbit.

name: Trans-Earth injection
description: The Earth return stage fires its engine and sends the Crew out of Mars orbit on their way home.
failureDescription: The Earth return stage's engine failed, leaving the Crew with no way out of Mars orbit.

name: Earth entry
description: The Crew's capsule came through Earth's atmosphere and splashed down under its parachutes.
failureDescription: The capsule's heat shield failed as it came into Earth's atmosphere.
